name: gitlab
description: Work with GitLab projects, branches, merge requests and pipelines; it can never merge.

base_url.title: Server URL
base_url.description: e.g. https://gitlab.example.com (no /api/v4, no credentials in the URL)

token.title: Access token
token.description: GitLab access token with api scope, sent as PRIVATE-TOKEN

default_project.title: Default project path (group/repo)
default_project.description: Project used when a tool call gives no project

english_only_writes.title: English-only writes
english_only_writes.description: When on, merge request titles, descriptions and comments with Chinese/Japanese/Korean characters are rejected (default off)
